tool_input.command:
cd <HOME>/Documents/Todoc/fpga/chip-design-skills; /c/Python314/python.exe -X utf8 - <<'EOF'
import json,glob,os
fs=sorted(glob.glob('.git/gmid-hook-probe/log/*.json'),key=os.path.getmtime)
for f in fs:
    try: d=json.load(open(f,encoding='utf-8'))
    except Exception as e: print(f,'unparsed'); continue
    ti=d.get('tool_input') or {}
    cmd=ti.get('command') or ti.get('file_path') or ''
    keys=[k for k in d if k not in ('session_id','transcript_path','scratchpad_dir','prompt_id','permission_mode','effort','tool_input','tool_response','tool_use_id','duration_ms','hook_event_name','tool_name','cwd','last_assistant_message')]
    out=''
    tr=d.get('tool_response')
    if isinstance(tr,dict): out=(tr.get('stdout') or '')[:60].replace('\n','|')
    print(os.path.basename(f)[:28], d.get('hook_event_name'), d.get('tool_name'), 'agent_type=',d.get('agent_type'),'agent_id=',(d.get('agent_id') or '')[:12], 'cwd=',d.get('cwd','')[-30:], 'extra=',keys, '|', str(cmd)[:50], '->', out)
EOF
